t: 12.05 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 62, Hankow Road. Incendiarism suspected. 1 house burnt. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
1 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 735, Nanking Road. Caused by burning Joss-paper. Damage trifling. Put out by the inmates and Police. No general alarm given.
4.45 a.m. Fire broke out on board Steamer "Peking" lying at the C. M. Central Wharf. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
8.30 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 20, Boone Road. Caused by the over heating of a stove-pipe. Damage trifling. Put out by the Police. No general alarm given.

6.43 p.m. Fire broke out in Messrs. Butterfield & Swire's godown on the French Bund. Supposed to be due to spontaneous combustion. Exact amount of damage unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.

3.50 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 874, New Seward Road. Caused by letting the cook-house fire burn after the occupants went to bed. Two (2) houses burnt. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
8.30 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 148, Hankow Road. Chimney caught fire and spread to the roof. Put out by the inmates and Police. Damage trifling. No general alarm given.
12.45 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 385, Pekin Road. Origin unknown. Two (2) houses burnt and four (4) damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
11.55 p.m. Fire broke out in an unoccupied house No. 415, Yunnan Road. Origin unknown. Four (4) houses burnt and three (3) damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
1.15 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 355, Honan Road, among some fire-wood. No damage done. Put out by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
1.35 p.m. Fire broke out at the Central Hotel, Nankin Road. One of the chimneys took fire. No damage done. Put out by inmates. No general alarm given.
3.25 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 991, Nankin Road. Cause of the fire unknown. Five (5) houses burnt, and four (4) Chinese perished in the flames. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
7.35 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 766, New Seward Road. Origin of the fire unknown. Six (6) houses burnt. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
11.45 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 375, Foochow Road. Incendiarism. No damage done. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
2.40 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 290, Chekiang Road. Origin unknown. Windows and roof burnt. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
7.25 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 812, Yuenchang Road. Caused by sparks from a chimney. Roof slightly damaged. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

10.30 a.m. Fire broke out in house No. 80, Kiangse Road. Caused by a chimney flue being too close to some woodwork. Part of the roof burned. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

3.12 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 457, Wuhu Road. One (1) house burnt, two (2) houses destroyed. Fire originated in the watchman's house. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
7.30 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 157, Woosung Road. Four (4) houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.

6 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 497, Honan Road. A quantity of cotton was set on fire by the carelessness of a Chinese boy, who was playing with some other boys. Cotton valued $10.00 burned. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

9.17 p.m. Fire broke out in the Lithographic Works, Nanking Road, No. 702. Originated through some coolies smoking in a room filled with paper. One (1) house burnt, one (1) damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
1.45 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 164, Tiendong Road. Origin unknown. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and occupants. No general alarm given.
6.10 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 108, Honan Road. Caused by sparks from a chimney igniting the roof. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
2.10 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 459, Hoopeh Road. Thirty-one (31) houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
9.20 p.m. Fire broke out in house No. 389, Szechuen Road. Three (3) houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
12.45 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 365, Kweichow Road. Four (4) houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
12.05 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 1017, Pekin Road. A cotton bed was burnt; a lighted candle came in contact with it. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
12.45 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 110, Yunnan Road, an unoccupied house. Incendiarism suspected. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and neighbours. No general alarm given.

10.30 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 343, Lloyd Road. The flooring was found to be on fire. Damage trifling. A woman and a boy were charged on suspicion with setting it on fire. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
11 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 312, Whakee Road. Caused by sparks igniting some straw. Damage trifling. Put out by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.
12.50 p.m. Fire broke out at Messrs. Major Brothers' Match Factory, Sinza. 19 houses, and 5 rooms in the main building burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.

2.05 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 661, Woosung Road, in an upstairs room. Caused by sparks igniting some wood-work. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

4.45 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 443, Wuhu Road. A quantity of bedding caught fire and was burned, through the carelessness of the inmates. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

5.12 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 743, Yuenfong Road, a Pawn-shop, which was totally destroyed. Caused by the negligence of a plumber, who was repairing the roof, letting some burning coal fall out of a stove he was using. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
9.55 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 161, Fuhkien Road. Origin unknown. Thirty-five (35) houses burnt, three (3) damaged. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
2.30 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 73, Chihli Road. One (1) house burnt, (1) damaged. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
10 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 105, Nankin Road. A beam became ignited through the overheating of a flue. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

5.52 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 18, Hankow Road, Messrs. Major Brothers' premises. Part of the roof and a quantity of paper destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
12.30 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 476, Pekin Road. A quantity of straw was on fire. Incendiarism suspected. Extinguished by the inmates. Damage trifling. No general alarm given.
5 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 219, Lloyd Road. A quantity of books burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Police and occupants. No general alarm given.
10.30 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 118, Woosung Road. A cotton bed and curtain burnt. Caused by upsetting a kerosine-oil lamp. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
10.45 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 234, Fohkien Road. Caused by upsetting a kerosine-oil lamp. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
3 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 232, Broadway Road. Origin unknown. Damage trifling. Put out by the Police and neighbours. No general alarm given.

3.32 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 42, Nanking Road, Messrs. Olsen & Salzwedel's Photographic Studio. Two (2) houses burnt, one (1) house much damaged by fire and water. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
9.30 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 186, Peking Road. One house burnt. Originated through the upsetting of a kerosine-oil lamp. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
7 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 1, Sungkiang Road. Origin unknown. Damage trifling. Put out by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

2.50 a.m. Fire broke out simultaneously in unoccupied house No. 149, Honan Road and the house opposite No. 312, Honan Road, "Sun Yuen's" Store. Sun Yuen's Store totally burnt down; the adjoining house much damaged by water. The unoccupied house opposite and adjoining one destroyed. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
4.52 a.m. Fire broke out in a house in French Concession near the French Central Police Station. Two houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.

4.35 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 815, Chekiang Road. Three (3) houses burnt. Caused through the carelessness of an old woman, who smoked opium. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
1 a.m. Fire broke out at No. 711, Fohkien Road, Fifty-one (51) houses burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
1 p.m. Fire broke out at No. 273, Kiukiang Road, a cook-shop. Slight damage done. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.
7.45 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 164, Woosung Road. No damage done. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Police. No general alarm given.
11.30 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 368, Broadway Road. Damage trifling. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Police and inmates. No general alarm given.

6.15 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 820, Fohkien Road. Ten (10) houses burnt and four (4) damaged. Originated through the upsetting of a kerosine-oil lamp. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
12.30 a.m. Fire broke out in an alley off Broadway Road, near Hongkew Bridge. Two (2) huts burnt, Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
11.20 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 149, Nanzing Road. One house burnt. Origin unknown. Extinguished by the Fire Brigade. General alarm given.
7.45 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 74, Chihli Road, (unoccupied house). Incendiarism. No damage done. Extinguished by the neighbours. No general alarm given.
12.45 a.m. Fire broke out at house No. 231, Pekin Road. Origin unknown. Damage trifling. Extinguished by the inmates. No general alarm given.

3.20 p.m. Fire broke out at house No. 220, Shantung Road. A quantity of straw and cotton-stalks caught fire in the cook-house. Damage trifling. Put out by the inmates and the Police with extincteurs. No general alarm given.
